userAgent.description: The client's User-Agent at sign-in (truncated to 255 characters). No IP address is stored.

current.description: Whether this is the session the request was made with

currentListed.description:
`false` when the request's token predates server-side
sessions, so this device isn't in the list until it
signs in again.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

403.description: Authenticated with a personal access token instead of a login session

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).
